beats.headline: A boy eagle in the temple
beats.text: For the record: Samantha was promised a chance to go into the temple of her mother, the goddess Theia, and went. She came back shouting. Her mother was an eagle. A boy eagle. The plan had counted on Theia's sponsor, an agent of the Open Intellect Pacifist Network, to have her clerics help at best. Nobody expected Samantha to meet the god in person. Sponsored gods may appear in their own form, and NPCs are meant to see the god regardless. Samantha did not. She calls him the imposter.

beats.headline: Reminded of the rules
beats.text: Baroness Victory returns to the room. Samantha accuses her of being in on it: Victory was there, and told the imposter he would not be allowed to help. Victory's ruling is that sponsors causing deities to act outside their nature is against faction wars rules. It gives an unfair advantage and happens anyway. She reminded both the Maestro and Rectrix of that before coming to watch Crawler Carl drop a bomb at his own feet. Crawler Carl does not think he has heard the name before. It sounds oddly familiar.

beats.headline: The Open Intellect's agent
beats.text: Crawler Carl is banned from every temple except his own and those where he has been named friend of the church. Theia is on that list. Of the gods on that list, Odette drives Nekhebit, and the Open Intellect's agent, Rectrix, drives Theia. So the male skyfowl in Theia's temple has a name, and a network behind him. All Rosetta has told Crawler Carl of the sponsor is that it is nobody he knows: a previous crawler activist who hates the dungeon as much as he does.

beats.headline: Work after the crawlers
beats.text: In a message to Justice Light, with the war mages holding the Gate, Rosetta lays out what is left. Perhaps the mages winning is not such a bad thing: it will be quick, and the remaining mercenaries and leaders will be dead. Justice Light says he is not done yet. If all the crawlers die, she answers, the Ascendency starts at once, and Rectrix gets to work. Perhaps, after all this, York and Rectrix survive. A longer crawl risks the AI growing stronger.

beats.headline: Not really your mother
beats.text: Samantha gives Tipid her account of the ninth floor. She went to kill her mother, Theia, and found some skyfowl dude instead, which has a way of messing with a girl's head. He told her, Look, I'm not really your mother. She told him no shit. He tried again: no, he meant Theia is not. She told him okay, weirdo. That is the whole of the exchange on file, and the subject is not named in it. Samantha moved on to the part where the whole club went nuts.
